summary: Verified the admin Leads and Site Visits fixes against the public deployment. Backend regression suite passed 12/12. Browser E2E confirmed all 10 lead filters render without crashes, lead status persists, Add Note succeeds, Site Visits loads both expected rows, site-visit status updates with a success toast and persists after reload, and tab switching produces no uncaught console/page errors or HTTP error responses. One requirement remains unmet: lead status changes show no success toast.

ui_bugs.issue: Changing a lead status succeeds and persists after reload, but no success toast appears. AdminSiteVisits provides the expected 'Status updated' feedback, while AdminLeads.updateField only reloads data.

action_items: Add a success toast after a successful AdminLeads.updateField status update, then retest the lead status flow.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminLeads.updateField has error feedback but no success feedback, which directly causes the remaining failed acceptance criterion.

The new update_site_visit endpoint accepts an unrestricted dict and writes all supplied fields; whitelist or validate mutable fields/status values with a Pydantic model to prevent invalid or unintended document mutations.
backend/server.py is far above the 700-line maintainability threshold and should be split into focused routers/services in a future refactor.
seed_data_creation: No reseed or new records. Added the required note 'QA browser regression note 2026-07' to an existing lead. Lead and Test Visitor statuses were restored to site_visit and confirmed after persistence checks.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL was used. All lead filter GETs returned 200 and rendered a row or empty state. Lead status API/UI persistence and Add Note passed. Site visit e2170553-06be-4dea-8e48-5f6dedabafb2 was changed to completed, verified after reload, then restored to confirmed. No console errors, page errors, HTTP >=400 responses, or React error overlays occurred during the clean regression run.
rca_of_the_issue: AdminLeads.updateField awaits PUT and calls load(), but unlike addNote and AdminSiteVisits.setStatus it never calls toast.success. Reproduction: Admin login -> Leads -> change the first row's status; the PUT returns 200 and reload proves persistence, but no success toast is rendered.
